fields.options:
Terms & Conditions

1. Registrations: Participants may register by e-mail with payment by cash, bank transfer or cheque.
2. Payment receipts: All registered delegates will receive an acknowledgement of registration, together with confirmation of payment.
3. Cancellations: Cancellations by delegates must be made in writing and received one week before the seminar. It is regretted that no refunds will be made or invoices cancelled after this date and the full registration fee will be payable. Substitutions may be made at any time.
4. Cancellation by organizers: We reserve the right to cancel the event if it is under subscribed or for any other reason. In the event of cancellation, we will endeavour to give delegates one-week notice and the fee will be refunded in full. We cannot be held liable for any pre-booked travel or accommodation costs.
5. Joining instructions: Two days before the training, we will email you information related to formalities at the venue, location, agenda, certification, etc.
6. If the delegate fails to appear for the training, the amount deposited will not be refunded.

fields.options:
NUMERO UNO Trainee Code of Conduct Policy
Training Course: _________________________________
Location: _____________
Trainer: ______________________
Date: _____________    Time: _____________

I, the undersigned, undertake to comply with all the principles listed at NUMERO UNO Trainee Code of Conduct Policy; as follows:

  1. Report to the training sessions on time.
  2. Demonstrate appropriate and respectful behaviour with trainers, fellow trainees and admin staff.
  3. Ensure disagreements or differences of opinion are expressed respectfully and resolved constructively.
  4. Adhere to the Centre’s dress code and professional attire.
  5. Observe confidentiality when dealing with personal, organizational, or proprietary information shared within the training environment.
  6. Perform all assessments and assignments with integrity and properly attribute sources when necessary.
  7. Handle the training facility, equipment, tools and training materials with care and I understand that I am accountable in cases of negligent behaviour; accidental or deliberate.
  8. Adhere to health, safety & Environment protocols and report hazards, when applicable.
  9. Seek and give constructive feedback from trainers and peers to improve learning and performance.
  10. Refrain from any harassment behaviour whether verbal, non-verbal or physical.

I understand that violations of the Code of Conduct may result in warnings, suspension, or expulsion from the training program.
